text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Back in spring, when I'd just been
accepted to Tracen Academy... I
remember
my mother poring over the school
pamphlet with a big grin.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"This academy really puts a lot of effort
into student life. Look,
they've even got
events in the dorms for Halloween and the
winter
holidays!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You're sure to make all sorts of friends.
Oh, Rob Roy, you're going to
have so
much fun at school!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The first step to making friends is making
good first impressions. I've
practiced a
bunch of ice breakers—I can do this!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... Why am I like this?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Wait, that's right! I've got a roommate now. If anyone, I have to make friends with her!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh, um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm, uh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Hold on. She'd probably think I'm weird if
I suddenly asked her to be
friends out of
nowhere.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Begging like that would just be admitting that I don't have any friends... And then she'd definitely steer clear of me...)
Squeeze.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! My mother used to hold my
hand like that when I was
nervous, and it
always made me feel better...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry though! I hope you didn't
mind it too much...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: N-not at all! I, um, I actually—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I was hoping we could be friends!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Rice always jumps right into action when
someone else needs help.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(She's been itching to say something to
Bourbon.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (It's written all over her face, but I haven't done anything to help—and I don't know what I possibly could do.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(After all, it'd only make things weird if I
tried to facilitate a
discussion. Maybe
someone else could, though. Someone
more
conversational than me...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (But deep down... I just...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh. "Get your ghoul on"... "Dress up and
unleash your inner devil"...
"Explore your
fantasies"...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Dead men do tell tales in this park-wide costume party. A limited-time dream world awaits—Halloween Land!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This is it! If I invite everyone, then...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Several flaws detected in current
Halloween party plans. Update
needed to
execute mission successfully.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Projections show risk of error in next
week's schedule. Primary

concern—processing prop orders—has
already been completed.
Attempting to
identify other sources of error...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I was going to talk to Bourbon.
But then I saw Tamamo and
Creek...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They didn't need me. I would've just been
in everyone's way... I got so
scared,
thinking awful things, and the next thing I
knew—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(I should stay out of their business.
Worrying and fussing isn't going
to
accomplish anything.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(I always go making things worse, so this
time, I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
H-hey you two! I order you... to be my
familiars!

text_block_list.name: Rice & Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm talking to you two!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: To... us? Even me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've got a task for you both! I require
familiars to escort me to
the theme park!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They're holding a Halloween event, but it
wouldn't be as fun alone.
Every good witch
knows that three heads are better than
one.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And it'll be suuuuuper fun, or so I've
heard! Inari said she used it as
inspiration
for planning last year's party.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway, it'll be a blast, and I really
wanna go! So, um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to turn you into my familiars with
magic and make you go
with me! I-if you
don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Student
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo, what should I dooo?! I was trying
to mend this shirt, but look
what I did...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't sweat it! I'll fix it up later, so
leave it there for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to check the costumes for
Miho Dorm, right? We
should start
rounding up the students who haven't
been fitted.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and while we're at it, I'll check up
on how Bourbon's gettin'
along.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I heard Bourbon's going to that crazy
scary theme park! She's
been struggling
with party ideas, so I guess she's going for
inspo.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: What, by herself? She's not taking on that place alone, is she? ...But I doubt she'd let us tag along. Sigh. I wish she'd rely on us more.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here we go again... Yeesh. Creek, would
you mind comin' with?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, not at all! I'll go get ready. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at all the cute little pumpkins!
And the dancers' costumes
are so floofy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, while I agree, that's not what we're
here for. Or, um... Move it,
you two! We've
got places to be!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Gruoooorgh... Aauuuuurgh...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Noise
text_block_list.text: Rustle... Rustle... Creak.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: W-well, looks like this is... the place...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack! Rumble...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Hold on to your tails!
Hurry—before they get taken!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice & Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice! Rob Roy!

With an echoing shriek, Rice Shower and
Zenno Rob Roy bolt, deaf
to Bourbon's
attempt to stop them. However, only a
zombie-infested
horrorscape lies ahead...

What nightmares await the three
here—none can know.
